correctness.rationale: The self-contained proof characterizes vertices and active facets using disjoint tight-edge path components, proves the exact earliest double-zero chains of length 2s+1, enumerates the first singular vertices, and proves total unimodularity by an incidence-matrix reduction. The independent rational-rank exhaustive enumeration checked 26 small parameter cases, 68,589 feasible lattice points, and 57 explicit witnesses through s=20. Finite evidence tests rather than replaces the universal proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Counts of lattice points in all dilates do not determine the complete face lattice, nor the exact incidence of the facets at vertices. Non-Gorenstein status does not imply nonsmoothness; a polytope can be smooth and non-Gorenstein. An enclosing-sphere contact classification does not count facets incident at every vertex. Therefore the cited conclusions do not logically entail the orientation-specific Delzant cutoffs.
